## Change Summary

- Prepare LoongForge v0.2.2 by updating `project.version` from the stale `0.1.0` value to `0.2.2`, following the latest published tag `v0.2.1`.
- Only package version metadata changes.

## Validation

- [x] Parsed `pyproject.toml` and confirmed the version is `0.2.2`.
- [x] Confirmed the only difference from upstream master is `project.version`.
- [x] Checked the PR title and ran `git diff --check`.
- [x] Ran the repository sensitive-information scanner, including history: no blocking findings; existing path and TODO warnings remain.

## CI, GPU, and Image Impact

- [x] No GPU or image validation is required for this metadata-only change.

## Reviewer Notes

After merging, select the corresponding master commit in the Release Portal and start a Formal release. The Portal creates the matching `v0.2.2` tag; the existing workflow builds the image, runs regression, and publishes images only after validation succeeds.

This PR does not create a tag or start a release. Release Notes are generated by the existing workflow after the formal release succeeds.
